title: Frappe 8.8.0 before 16.30.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the SMS Settings…
description: Frappe versions from 8.8.0 up to but not including 16.30.0 have an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the SMS Settings get_contact_number API. This flaw allows attackers with some privileges to retrieve phone numbers of arbitrary Contact records without proper permission checks, exposing personally identifiable information (PII). The vulnerability arises from an uncorrelated EXISTS subquery used in the endpoint.
